title: Mushroom Dreamer Under Stars
description: A man with dark skin and curly hair lies on his back at the base of a massive, moss-covered tree, wearing a blue plaid shirt. His arms are spread wide as he gazes upward at a starry night sky filled with constellations, surrounded by glowing white mushrooms, tall grass, and scattered terracotta pots.
prompt: A man with dark skin and curly hair lies peacefully on his back at the base of an enormous ancient tree covered in green moss, wearing a blue plaid shirt with arms spread wide. He is surrounded by clusters of glowing white mushrooms and tall golden grass with scattered broken terracotta pots. The background shows a starry night sky transitioning from deep purple to twilight with visible constellations, in a detailed fantasy illustration style.
